title: ASCII Codes
description: A comprehensive reference table for ASCII character codes with decimal, octal, hexadecimal, binary representations and character descriptions

    "type": "calculator",
    "content": "Convert between ASCII code formats",
    "inputs": [
      {
        "id": "decimal_input",
        "label": "Decimal",
        "type": "number",
        "defaultValue": 128
      }
    ],
    "outputs": [
      {
        "id": "octal_output",
        "label": "Octal",
        "formula": "inputs.decimal_input.toString(8)"
      },
      {
        "id": "hex_output",
        "label": "Hexadecimal",
        "formula": "inputs.decimal_input.toString(16).toUpperCase()"
      },
      {
        "id": "binary_output",
        "label": "Binary",
        "formula": "inputs.decimal_input.toString(2).padStart(8, '0')"
      }
    ]
